method: Walked the rendered photo page and an album page on a dev server. The only reader-visible change is what the Copy link button puts on the clipboard: it now appends ?src=share-copy, matching what every other copy-link in the app already did. Button labels, aria-labels and toast copy are unchanged (verified in the served HTML: aria-label='Copy link to this photo', visible 'Copy link', album 'Share'). Also verified the inbound half against the real database — one arrival with ?src=share-copy and a browser user-agent wrote the expected engagement_events row (event_type view, source share-copy); a curl user-agent was correctly bot-filtered.
